How bomprobe Works

Feed it any SBOM. It parses the format, runs 126 quality checks, scores the result, checks compliance, and outputs in the format your CI pipeline needs.

1
Ingest
Auto-detect CycloneDX or SPDX. Parse JSON, validate structure, extract components.
2
Normalize
SPDX docs are mapped to a common internal model. Both formats get the same checks.
3
Analyze
Run 126 weighted checks across five categories. Each produces typed findings.
4
Score
Weighted 0-100 score with A-F grading. Threshold gates for CI pass/fail.
5
Report
16 output formats. Terminal, CI annotations, SARIF, HTML, JUnit, and more.
🔎
126 Quality Checks
Five categories, weighted by supply chain impact
Name Version PURL Supplier Hash License Type Scope CPE Integrity Ownership Ecosystem Timestamp Tools Author BOM ID Lifecycle Coverage Depth Orphans Cycles Namespace Relationships Creator Verification SPDX Expr Copyleft Deprecated
✅
Compliance Profiles
Regulatory frameworks with specific field requirements
NTIA U.S. minimum elements: supplier, name, version, identifier, relationships, author, timestamp
BSI TR-03183 German federal guideline: hashes, supplier URLs, license info, component relationships
EU CRA Cyber Resilience Act: vulnerability contacts, update info, complete dependency trees
Scoring Engine
F
D

A
Weighted score 0-100 with configurable thresholds and fail-on severity
